title: tasks: update_task_per_user auth says read access, spec says mayUpdatePrivate
description: crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/backend.rs update_task_per_user 'Authorisation contract' says read access to the Task suffices for per-user writes. draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06 §3 TaskRights grants per-user property writes via mayUpdatePrivate ('The user may modify the following properties on all tasks in the task list, even if they would not otherwise have permission'). Sibling calendars-server update_per_user_properties requires mayUpdatePrivate (calendars-33 §4). Align the tasks rustdoc (and MemoryBackend if affected). Found during JMAP-9tp3.
